locale.description: The locale to be used for sorting, formatting, and character encoding across coreutils.

ls_format.description: Default arguments for ls/vdir/dircolors related behavior.

numfmt_base.description: The default numeric base for numfmt output (e.g., 10 for decimal, 16 for hexadecimal).

use_ext_attrs.description: Whether to enable extended attribute support where applicable by the runtime environment.
